ZONINGLOT&DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT,made this 13th day of September, 2004,by and between CENTRAL PROPERTIES LLC, having an office c/o ELK INVESTORS, 641 Lexington Avenue, NewYork,NewYork10022(hereinafterreferred toas“Seller"),andALLENREALTY ASSOCIATES NYLLC,having an office c/o The Pomeranc Group,2057 Center Street, Fort Lee, New Jersey 07024 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner owns certain land, with the building and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known as 191-193 Orchard Street, New York, New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto (said land being herein called the "Owner's Land," said building and improvements, together with any replacements thereof, being herein called the "Owner's Building," and said land and building and improvements being herein called the "Owner's Property"); and Borough of Manhattan, generally known as 183-187 Orchard Street, a/k/a 192-196 Allen Street, New York, New York, more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto (hereinafter referred to as the "Developer's Land") with the building and improvements situate thereon (the"Existing Building"); WHEREAS, the Owner's Land and the Developer's Land qualify for single zoning lot treatment pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, as the same has been or may be hereafter amended (the "Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, Developer presently intends to construct a new building on the thereto, being herein called the "Developer's Building"); and WHEREAS, it is planned that the Developer's Building will contain more floor area, as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution, than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to the Developer's Land as a "zoning lot," and, accordingly, the Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining the Developer's Land and the Owner's Land into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the Developer's Building with such limitation; and WHEREAS, such procedure would make available to Developer for such purpose 9,847 square feet of the development rights thereto (which 9,847 square feet of unused development rights thereto are hereinafter collectively called the"Excess Zoning Rights") available to the Owner's Property under the Zoning Resolution and the Owner is willing to make such procedure available to Developer for such purpose; WHEREAS, the parties hereto are, simultaneously herewith, executing and delivering a Declaration of Restrictions, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (herein called the"Declaration")which makes such procedures available to Developer for such the Owner's Land and theDeveloper's Land: NOW,THEREFORE,in consideration of the foregoing,the parties hereto hereby agreeasfollows: 1.Owner hereby covenants and agrees that no building or other improvement shall be constructed or allowed to exist on the Owner's Land and/or Owner's Building nor shall any reconstruction, repair or rebuilding of the existing improvements on the Owner's Land at a height greater than the height of the roof of the Owner's Building as it now exists, plus, such height as may be permitted by using any other development rights allowed to Owner's Land pursuant to the Resolution (other than the Development Rights, as defined above) or otherwise permitted by applicable law, and further plus any mechanical installations or equipment on the roof of the Owner's Building (including, without limitation, water tower and elevator existing installation or equipment which, together with any replacements thereof or additions thereto, may continue to exist at their present height or law. 2.Owner hereby transfers to Developer the Excess Zoning Rights and agrees with Developer that Developer may incorporate into the Developer's Building and utilize such Excess Zoning Rights to develop the Developer's for the Excess Zoning Rights, Owner shall retain all rights in and to the Developer's Land and Existing Building and Developer shall have no rights thereto.Owner covenants and agrees to cooperate with Developer in all reasonable respects relating to the legal implementation of incorporating into the Developer's Building the Excess Zoning Rights and to execute all documents and consents pertaining thereto and reasonably required therefor provided that: (a) any action requested of Owner by Developer pursuant to this paragraph 2 shall be without cost to Owner, or without recourse to Owner; (b) if Developer shall request any such action on the part of Owner, Developer shall pay any reasonable attorneys' fees incurred by Owner in connection with any such action; (c) the parties acknowledge that cooperation by Owner shall not include anyaction which would (i) adversely affect thevalue of the Owner's
